messages.subject: Image rename - error message
parts:
Hello,

I'm using camtrapR to manage three large data sets for my PhD project (about 353, 000 images in total) - thus far camtrapR has been very helpful!

I have encountered a problem that I don't know how to fix. I'm trying to move and rename my images (which I've managed to do successfully with two of my data sets), but for my largest dataset I'm getting a lot of error messages. I'll run the code and it will work until it gets to a particular station, and then it gives me the following error:

I managed to stop the error from happening because the raw image folder for that particular station had a lot of folders within folders, so I manually moved all the camera trap image into the 'camera' folder. The error no longer comes up when I get to that station, however I am now getting the same error on another station further on down the list, and moving the images into the relevant 'camera' folder is no longer fixing the problem. Any tips?

Thanks in advance!
Jess

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Image rename - error message
parts:
Dear Jess,
all I can say at this point is that this should not be happening and very clearly is a bug. It seems to have to do with assigning the camera ID in the output table, but I'm not sure yet. Would you please provide the output of sessionInfo()? And the directory structure of the station directory that caused the trouble? If possible, I'd appreciate very much if you could dropbox me that directory (or a subset thereof) via email for me to reproduce, understand and then fix the problem, as I haven't seen it before.
Also, does the function copy anything at all?

Normally, folders within folders should be no problem, as the software will recursively find all JPG images in subdirectories. And manually having to move directories is something that camtrapR was meant to render unnecessary, so I hope I'll be able to provide a solution soon.

Best regards,
Jürgen
